answer: Merge the cuttings. Like willow branches struck from one parent root, accounts seeded by the same first-funding transaction get their votes merged: the scorer traces every opening balance to its river of origin and clusters clones sharing that haven of funding. A sybil farm can mint a thousand wallets instantly, but weight accrues only per independent origin, forcing the attacker to buy N separated on-ramp payments with distinct counterparties, fees, and staggered timestamps - linear cost per fake identity.
